title: Detent Engage — promotional cut
reader: A CRO or founder who already has, or has considered, a chat agent on their website.
reaction: Ours bills us whether it helps or not. This one doesn't.
model: A monthly subscription buying replies and voice minutes, drawn against included credits, with a cap on billable replies per conversation and a hard spend cap per account. A reply that could not answer from approved knowledge is not billed at all.
note: An earlier cut claimed the product is paid per confirmed outcome. It is not: that is one line item on some plans, not the basis of the relationship. No code, no JSON, no configuration screens.

beats.big:
Most AI assistants
charge you when they fail.

A monthly subscription
for replies and voice minutes.
beats.small: A reply that could not answer is not one of them.

beats.lower: When it does not know, it says so, and hands you to a person.

beats.small: Your current vendor cannot tell you.

beats.big:
A cap per conversation.
A spend cap per account.
beats.small: The worst case is a number you see before you sign.

beats.lower: It tells every visitor it is AI.
It will not try to identify anyone until they say yes.
It answers only from knowledge you approved. It qualifies. It books.

beats.small: You pay for the answers, not for the apologies.
